source: Anthropic first-party API list prices (the claude-api model table cached 2026-10-06); USD per million tokens
notes: cache_write is the 5-minute TTL rate, 1.25 x input. cache_read is the published rate where it departs from 0.1 x input (Fable 5.1 0.25, Opus 5.5 0.20).
tiers: a request whose prompt (input + cache read + cache write) is over above_prompt_tokens is billed at the tier's rates; cache rates scale with input.
Models served elsewhere (LM Studio, Ollama, Runpod, a subscription CLI) have no row: their cost is null, not zero.
